caption: The upgrade path: pass Element 3 (35 questions, 26 correct to pass, Element 2 already credited); at the session the Form 605 is properly submitted to the VEs and the CSCE is in your hand — and from that moment you may use General privileges immediately under §97.9(b), signing /AG on every transmission that uses them. When the ULS record shows General — typically within days — you drop the suffix; you keep your call sign. The interim authority ends at final disposition of the application or 365 days after passing, whichever comes first.
spoken: five boxes — pass Element 3; CSCE plus Form 605; on the air at once signing slash A G; ULS shows General; drop the A G
